what: Discord hackathon resource roundup published in Slack with a channel mention and a project-application thread
why: The team needs the sponsor setup guides, credit instructions, judging rubrics and Maker Arm integration lead in one place for The Human Touch.
details: The 11:21 AM Discord announcement identifies dc/maker_arm as a Portal branch with Maker Arm support. Review it against the installed SDK and station before treating the adapter milestone as complete. LiveKit's starter guide covers Dream-1 examples and voice control. Dream Labs shared an account-first credit form and Creative/Hill Climb rubric PDFs at 11:13 AM. DIMOS shared perception/agent/memory docs, a Metal integration guide, an Autoresearch/Dream Labs branch, a CLI SOP PDF and a demonstration video. These can inform perception, learning and evaluation work, with Maker Arm compatibility still requiring verification. The connector rejected direct publishing to Slack Connect; its prepared drafts were sent through the Slack desktop app. The published parent and thread reply were verified.
